name: Agrim
reason: Common modern name from agrima, foremost; meaning correct.

name: Ahaan
reason: Devanagari/IAST (ahan, short a) do not match the name as written with long aa; modern name, derivation from ahan is popular but uncertain.

fix.name: Ahaan
fix.meaning_en: Dawn, first light of morning (modern name; popularly linked to Sanskrit ahan 'day', etymology uncertain).

name: Aniket
reason: Well-established given name; epithet of Shiva widely used for boys; meaning correct.

name: Ayansh
reason: IAST lacks the long a shown in the Devanagari अयांश; meaning should be stated plainly as uncertain.

fix.name: Ayansh
fix.meaning_en: Modern name; etymology uncertain (popularly explained as 'part of the divine' or 'ray of light').

name: Darsh
reason: Common name; darśa means sight and the new-moon day; neutral and correct.

name: Harshil
reason: Popular modern name built on harṣa, joy; meaning reasonable.

name: Kairav
reason: Kairava, the white night-blooming lotus; auspicious and correct.

name: Kanav
reason: Script कण्व reads Kanva, not Kanav as written; Kanav is the modern variant of the sage's name.

fix.name: Kanav
fix.meaning_en: Modern form of Kanva, a revered Vedic sage and foster-father of Shakuntala.

name: Krish
reason: कृष without virama reads kṛṣa ('thin, emaciated'); should be written with halant as a short form of Krishna.

name: Laksh
reason: Lakṣa, aim or target; common name; meaning correct.

name: Lakshit
reason: Lakṣita, distinguished, marked; common name; correct.

name: Nimai
reason: Childhood name of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu; genuine Vaishnava boy's name; correct.

name: Parv
reason: Parva, festival or sacred occasion; common modern name; correct.

name: Prakhar
reason: Prakhara, sharp, brilliant; common name; correct.

name: Rachit
reason: Racita, created, composed; common name; correct.

name: Saarth
reason: Sārtha, meaningful; sandhi sa + artha correct; auspicious.

name: Vansh
reason: Vaṃśa, lineage; very common boy's name; correct.

name: Ved
reason: Veda, sacred knowledge; common name; correct.

name: Vedik
reason: Script वैदिक/vaidika does not match Vedik as written; Vedik is a modern form of vaidika.

fix.name: Vedik
fix.meaning_en: Of the Vedas, sacred (modern form of Vaidika).

name: Vihaan
reason: Very popular modern name; meaning already marks etymology as uncertain; script matches.
